<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Sunbird Glare](/Feats.aspx?ID=5531) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 82

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

**Requirements**
You’re in [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407)

</column>

---

By keeping your feathers clean and sleek, you can catch the light across your wings to create a startling glare in the eyes of a creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). Regardless of their result, the target is temporarily immune to Sunbird Glare for 10 minutes.
name: Sunbird Glare
